head: codex/5871-capability-advertisement
title: [v0.92][WP-04.09] Signed capability advertisements
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5871

Implements canonical, domain-separated Ed25519-signed capability advertisements whose projection is verified evidence only, never grant or scheduling authority. Verification binds the exact live AdvertisementSigning certificate, trust domain, holder, generation, subject key, and certificate ID; rejects stale, future, expired, revoked, replayed, malformed, noncanonical, oversized, or incorrectly authorized input; and persists bounded per-certificate replay high-water state through the certificate horizon.

Validation:
- `cargo nextest run --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_capability_advertisement --no-tests=fail` (12 passed)
- strict focused Clippy with `-D warnings` (unrelated preexisting `acip.rs` lint explicitly allowed)
- exact two-revision WP-04.09 proof receipt PASS
- independent security/correctness review PASS with no findings

The module remains intentionally unregistered until WP-04.16/#5878.
